title: grumilea cephalophora
intro: Grumilea cephalophora, commonly known as Yellow Bells, is a flowering plant native to tropical Africa. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its numerous health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Grumilea cephalophora include its ability to reduce inflammation, exhibit antioxidant activity, and display antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its traditional uses. The bioactive constituents of Grumilea cephalophora include flavonoids, alkaloids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
